zotero.abstractNote: Impaired control (IC) is a core symptom of alcohol use disorder (AUD) and is thought to be linked to deficits in inhibitory control. However, the extent to which IC symptoms are associated with behavioral and neural markers of inhibitory control remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the relationship between IC symptoms and behavioral and neural markers of inhibitory control in a sample of individuals with AUD. We found that IC symptoms were associated with both behavioral and neural markers of inhibitory control, suggesting that IC symptoms may be a useful clinical marker for inhibitory control deficits in AUD.
